rationale: This record is a book review of a macroeconomic history volume on Peru covering prices, population, demand and production since 1700. It does not address household or community water or sanitation service access (Criterion 1), does not present primary empirical research or a systematic review (Criterion 3), and examines no water/sanitation access outcomes or legal/administrative mechanisms (Criteria 2 and 4). Excluded under primary code E01 (wrong topic).
plain_vs_narrow_note: No difference between plain and narrow Criterion 2 readings; the record is a book review on general Peruvian economic history (prices, population, demand and production since 1700) and fails Criterion 1, Criterion 3, and Criterion 4 under both readings.
